thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 5xx rate detected for /v1/embeddings in eu-central-1. Current error rate ~18% over 5m window. Severity: P1. @eng-oncall paging rotation.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started: service=embeddings, artifact=emb-v2-quant, rollout_id=rl-202633-79, targets=eu-central-1 canaries (5%). Triggered by: automated release pipeline.

maya: seeing alerts in grafana — latency jump + 502/503s. dashboard link: https://grafana.company/sg/f/embeddings-eu

jordan: I'm on it. taking lead for mitigation.

sam: confirmed — synthetic hit against canary returns 502 after ~100ms of normal response. Curl: `curl -v https://eu.api.redwood/embeddings -d '{"input":"test"}'` -> `HTTP/1.1 502`

lucy: support queue: ~12 open tickets tied to embeddings failing on EU customers. One enterprise customer reported webhook retries from their side. Escalating.

jordan: initial hypothesis: quantized kernel change in emb-v2 introduced a path that fails on specific GPU driver versions. We rolled this to canary only but traffic steering still sending small percentage to canary.

jordan: attempting immediate mitigation: toggling feature-flag emb_v2_rollout -> OFF (kill)

eng-release: Flag toggle submitted: `flagctl set emb_v2_rollout false --env=prod --scope=eu-central`

ops-miguel: flag toggled, control-plane acked. However some frontends still show backend version v2 in their route table. Suspect stale connection pools / long-lived workers.

maya: any chance of draining? can we mark canary pool out-of-service?

ops-miguel: running scale-down/drain on canary nodes now:

```
# mark as draining
kubectl label nodes canary-emb-01 canary=drain --overwrite
kubectl cordon canary-emb-01
kubectl delete pod -l canary=emb-v2 --grace-period=30
```

sam: I'm seeing partial improvements but still ~4% errors. Traces show a mix of v1 and v2 paths; upstream CDN caches may still route some requests to old sticky backends.

jordan: switching traffic routing policy to hard-steer away from eu-canaries (regional router): `route-manager set-route embeddings --region eu-central --target pool-v1 --force`

deploy-bot: route-manager action accepted, mirror/steer in progress.

lucy: Customer comms drafted: short status update and ETA for full rollback. sent to SRE-runbook channel for signoff.

jordan: handoff: I need to step out for call in 10m. @sam you're taking on-call lead for live mitigation and customer impact assessment. Outline: confirm errors under 1%, ensure all canaries drained, confirm no residual v2 connections at LB/edge, coordinate support comms.

sam: taking lead. On it.

ops-miguel: draining continuing. I see nodes reaped, new requests being answered by v1 only. Error rate trending down to ~0.8% across EU in the last 3m.

sam: good — monitoring traces for tail latencies. Also verifying healthcheck responses across edge POPs.

incident-bot: NOTE: automated incident timer started (started_at=3331234567). Escalation policy: if not resolved in 30m, page SRE-lead.

sam: support update: pushing out customer note now. Logged Affected customers: list attached to ticket #INC-2209.

maya: can we confirm rollback status for artifact? did deploy pipeline auto-rollback or do we need manual rollback?

eng-release: Canary rollout aborted. No full rollout. No artifact rollback required. All canary pods marked failed and removed. We'll run a cleanup job to ensure no leftover kernels loaded.

ops-miguel: final check: ingress logs show no v2 request headers in last 2m. healthchecks green. Error rate stabilized ~0.2%.

sam: marking mitigated. I'll keep monitoring for 45m and then close the thread. Preparing quick RCA draft: root cause likely kernel mismatch with quant path + insufficient pool isolation for canary (sticky sessions). Follow-ups: improve canary isolation (hard steering), add driver compatibility gating in CI, make flag toggles force-evict connections.

lucy: customer comms sent and updated. No further escalations right now.

jordan: thanks team. handoff acknowledged. Sam — ping if anything spikes.

sam: will do. closing handoff to night rotation at 3331234605. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: P1 -> mitigated. duration ~38m. Postmortem: please create doc in /postmortems/embedding-canary-eu-3331234567 within 48h.
